title: Census Building Permits State Change Feed
description: Compare official monthly state residential building permit estimates, preserving FIPS, source snapshots, imputation and dollar units.

period.title: Current period
period.description: YYYY-MM (2000 onward), or latest to discover the latest published monthly file.

previous_period.title: Comparison period
previous_period.description: YYYY-MM, earlier than current period. Omit for preceding calendar month.

states.title: State FIPS codes
states.description: Two-digit strings, e.g. ["01","22","28"]. Empty means all 50 states and DC.
